title: openserve Catalog Model Manifest
description: Schema for model manifests in the openserve catalog

id.description: Unique identifier for the model (lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and dots)

hfRepo.description: HuggingFace repository in org/repo format (e.g., meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct)

hfRevision.description: Git SHA or tag for the specific model revision on HuggingFace

weightDigestSha256.description: SHA256 digest of the resolved model weights archive

cosignManifest.description: URL to the cosign bundle for verifying model authenticity

license.description: License under which the model is distributed

minGPUClass.description: Minimum GPU class required to effectively run the model

maxContextLen.description: Maximum context length (tokens) supported by the model

recommendedVLLMArgs.description: Recommended command-line arguments for vLLM deployment

description.description: Brief description of the model and its capabilities

tags.description: Tags for categorization (e.g., instruction-tuned, code, multilingual)

addedAt.description: Date when the model was added to the catalog (YYYY-MM-DD)

addedBy.description: GitHub username of the maintainer who verified and added the model

modelType.description: Model capability type. 'chat' for text generation, 'embedding' for vector embeddings.

embeddingDimensions.description: Output vector dimensions for embedding models (e.g. 768). Required when modelType is 'embedding'.
